headline: PM Tarique orders release of teacher detained over alleged remarks
summary: The Prime Minister directed police to release a Kushtia teacher with dignity, stating that freedom of expression should be respected even when others disagree.
details: Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has directed the police to release a school teacher in Kushtia who was detained over alleged derogatory remarks about him.
Mahdi Amin, the PM's adviser and spokesperson, stated that the Prime Minister was upset to learn of the detention and ordered the teacher's safe return home with dignity.
The PM emphasized that people are entitled to their own opinions and that respect for differing views is a strength of democracy.
Golam Kibria Lalon, a Bangla teacher at Pragpur Secondary School, was detained on Wednesday following complaints from students and guardians.
Students alleged that Lalon commented on the Prime Minister's Bangla pronunciation during a recent UN General Assembly speech and made other objectionable remarks.
The incident led to tension in the area, with guardians and residents gathering at the school to demand action against the teacher.
Lalon was detained from the Bheramara-Pragpur regional highway area around 11:00 am on Wednesday.
The teacher has denied making any derogatory remarks during the questioning conducted by the school's headteacher and former chairman.
caption:
Freedom of expression is a strength of democracy. PM Tarique Rahman orders the release of a teacher detained for alleged remarks about him.

Prime Minister Tarique Rahman has directed the police to release a school teacher in Kushtia who was detained over alleged derogatory remarks about him.

Mahdi Amin, the PM's adviser and spokesperson, stated that the Prime Minister was upset to learn of the detention and ordered the teacher's safe return home with dignity.

The PM emphasized that people are entitled to their own opinions and that respect for differing views is a strength of democracy.

Golam Kibria Lalon, a Bangla teacher at Pragpur Secondary School, was detained on Wednesday following complaints from students and guardians.

Students alleged that Lalon commented on the Prime Minister's Bangla pronunciation during a recent UN General Assembly speech and made other objectionable remarks.

The incident led to tension in the area, with guardians and residents gathering at the school to demand action against the teacher.

Lalon was detained from the Bheramara-Pragpur regional highway area around 11:00 am on Wednesday.

The teacher has denied making any derogatory remarks during the questioning conducted by the school's headteacher and former chairman.

headline_marked: Co-pilot [[stabs captain to try and crash plane]] during Dubai-Tel Aviv flight
headline: Co-pilot stabs captain to try and crash plane during Dubai-Tel Aviv flight
summary: A flydubai flight plunged 14,000 feet in 30 seconds after a co-pilot allegedly attacked the captain in the cockpit, according to Israeli officials.
details: A flydubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv plunged more than 14,000 feet in 30 seconds after a co-pilot allegedly stabbed the captain, according to Israeli officials.
Passengers reported feeling massive turbulence as the plane veered northwest, briefly crossing into Jordan before returning to Saudi airspace.
The wounded captain reportedly used his remaining energy to open the cockpit door, allowing passengers and crew to enter and stop the attacking pilot.
A video verified by Reuters shows two bloodied men on the cockpit floor, identifying one as the pilot who was attacked and the other as the co-pilot.
A reserve crew on board took control of the aircraft and landed it safely at Tabuk Airport in Saudi Arabia.
Flydubai has stated that the underlying reasons for the event remain unknown and has cautioned against premature speculation.
caption:
A flight plunged 14,000 feet in 30 seconds after a co-pilot allegedly stabbed the captain to try and crash the plane.

A flydubai flight FZ1073 from Dubai to Tel Aviv plunged more than 14,000 feet in 30 seconds after a co-pilot allegedly stabbed the captain, according to Israeli officials.

Passengers reported feeling massive turbulence as the plane veered northwest, briefly crossing into Jordan before returning to Saudi airspace.

The wounded captain reportedly used his remaining energy to open the cockpit door, allowing passengers and crew to enter and stop the attacking pilot.

A video verified by Reuters shows two bloodied men on the cockpit floor, identifying one as the pilot who was attacked and the other as the co-pilot.

A reserve crew on board took control of the aircraft and landed it safely at Tabuk Airport in Saudi Arabia.

Flydubai has stated that the underlying reasons for the event remain unknown and has cautioned against premature speculation.
